domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction parts inside mixed-number subtraction as well as pure fractions.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that add a whole denominator unit such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24 after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number or normalizing an improper mixed number unless the step also performs denominator matching.

skills.name: Rewrite operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or mixed number into a subtraction-ready whole-plus-fraction form, including normalizing a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus zero fractional part, such as 2 + 0/3 or 4 + 0/8.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fraction parts to support part-by-part subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag common-denominator conversion between unlike fractions.
Do not tag borrowing one whole during subtraction after a negative fractional difference appears.
Do not tag final recombination of computed parts into the stated answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after rewriting or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-presentation-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow one whole and convert it into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part after obtaining or anticipating a negative fractional difference.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into denominator-sized fractional units such as 3/3, 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24.
Tag for mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction where regrouping is needed to complete the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no borrowing is needed.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless the step actually performs borrowing.
Do not tag simplification after regrouped subtraction is finished.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or simplify a zero fractional part to a simpler whole-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed-number result is simplified because its fractional part can be reduced.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a result in lowest terms with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fraction parts unless reduction or simplification is also performed in that step.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts, or present the result in final acceptable form as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into a mixed number.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction, or a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer result.
Tag when the step's main action is stating the final answer from already computed parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless they also explicitly form the final presented answer from computed parts.
Do not tag setup steps that only rewrite operands before subtraction.
